# ecj 3.46.100 source inclusion

ecj is the work of its upstream authors and contributors. Copyright remains with the copyright
holders named in each unchanged source file and in the retained legal texts. This directory does not
relabel upstream implementation as M3jdk21-original.

Upstream: https://github.com/eclipse-jdt/eclipse.jdt.core/tree/8634087ceb99426b43565db17d8c1456d9e4d782/org.eclipse.jdt.core.compiler.batch
Published sources jar: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jdt/ecj/3.46.100/ecj-3.46.100-sources.jar (SHA-1 63a7b02952221106d1f1095048e7d8a4d599d7c2)
License as declared by the published pom: EPL-2.0

The complete upstream license text is retained in `LICENSE` (fetched from the upstream tag; see UPSTREAM_LICENSE.json),
alongside this notice and `PROVENANCE.json`. Every file listed in `SOURCES_MANIFEST.tsv` retains its exact
upstream bytes and header. No build descriptor is generated: donor-superset status FAILED (EXTRA_BINARY_CLASSPATH;SIGNED_SOURCES_JAR).
